extracted.intended_audience: readers and students of art history; scholars interested in the history of sculpture, painting, and architecture
extracted.subtask_short: art history narrative on design arts
extracted.subtask_description: A historical narrative tracing the origins, decline, and revival of the arts of sculpture, painting, and architecture (ancient through medieval to early Renaissance), describing causes, examples, and cultural transmission. Not a how-to or evaluation rubric but a descriptive account of artistic development and material culture.
